caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, specifically a vest, laid flat and viewed from the front. The vest is primarily a light beige or cream color and features a subtle repeating pattern made up of small red and slightly darker tan lines that resemble foliage or leaf-like motifs. The vest has a notched collar, a V-shaped neckline, and is fastened with four round, brown or brass buttons vertically aligned down the center. There are two pockets, one on each side at the lower front, partially obscured by the shape of the garment. The edges and seams are visible, and the fabric exhibits slight wrinkles and folds, particularly near the bottom and around the pockets. The background is a plain, off-white or light tan, with no other objects depicted in the drawing.
title: Quilted Silk Vest
